content: पुरोधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To place or put in the front or at the head, make as a leader; तुरासाहं पुरोधाय धाम स्वायंभुवं ययुः <ls>Ku. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 43</ls>. .²2 To make a family-priest of any one. .²3 To appoint, place in office. .²4 To entrust or charge with. .²5 To place or set before or in front to. .²6 To honour, esteem, respect. .²7 To devote or apply oneself to. .²8 To think, ponder over.
